title: Arithmetic geometry
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Chulalongkorn University
about: CIMPA research school at Chulalongkorn University, Bangkok, 17-28 May 2027, bridging students with some algebra and number theory background to active research topics in arithmetic geometry. There is no registration fee; applications close 17 January 2027.
requirements: For students with some background in algebra and number theory
CIMPA schools are primarily aimed at students and teacher-researchers based in developing countries; a small number of students from other countries may attend
Applications via the CIMPA application site before the deadline
